note_en: 不但……而且…… means "not only... but also...": 他不但用广东话和普通话唱歌，而且他的声音适合……各种歌曲 "he not only sings in Cantonese and Mandarin, but his voice also suits all kinds of songs." When both clauses share a subject, 不但 comes after it; when the subjects differ, as here (他 / 他的声音), the second subject comes after 而且. The second part usually adds something stronger than the first.
